free_text: 63-year-old man, prior negative biopsy. PI-RADS 4, PSA 6.1 ng/mL, PSAD 0.08. A PI-RADS 4 lesion after a negative biopsy is an indication for a repeat, targeted biopsy of the visible lesion. Against that, the previous biopsy was benign and the PSA density is low at 0.08. Biopsy; there is no rush: waiting a year is tolerable if he prefers, with a new biopsy within a few years.
